summary.en: Over the whole desk one pencil stroke joins every region the ring visited, in order, along a lane above the prints.
summary.zh: 俯瞰整张桌面，一笔铅笔线按顺序连起圈过的每个区域，沿截图上方的一条走线。

fits: The close of a film that pointed at several pieces of evidence.
notFor: A single piece of evidence; regions on one print only (ring them instead).

intent.en: Retrace the argument as one path through the evidence before the name.
intent.zh: 在名字出现前，把整条论证当作穿过证据的一条路线重走一遍。

content.en: The regions ringed during the film, in order (one per read, both sides of each match).
content.zh: 片中圈过的区域，按顺序（每次读数一处，每次匹配两侧各一处）。

fits.zh: 指过多处证据的片子的收尾。

notFor.zh: 只有一处证据；只在一张截图上的区域（直接圈）。

pairs.note: drawn after the rule under the name

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
